actions.action: Check whether the pot has drainage holes
If no drainage holes, put the plant in a nursery pot with holes inside the decorative pot
Check the top 3–5 cm of soil with a finger and water only when dry
Move the plant to a brighter spot with indirect light
Cut off the yellow stem at the base with clean scissors
